notes.title: Spartan VR Update - August 3rd, 2017
notes.content:
[h1]Spartan VR Update - August 3rd, 2017[/h1]

Hello, World!

We have worked for some time to make our game more interesting, so here we are!
Still, it's not a final update and a lot of new features will be added, but since we have received feed back from you we decided to concentrate our attention on motion mode and we are ready to introduce to you our first Spartan VR update:

[list]
    [*] New motion mode has been added. Now it's possible to choose between teleport mode and free motion mode;
    [*] Weapon holding mode was fixed. Now you can hold weapon without holding controller trigger;
    [*] New sound effects of mob respawn have been added. Now you will be alerted when enemy will be near;
    [*] Fixed some weapon textures and bugs.
[/list]

We will be happy to have some comments dedicated to updates and game itself!

Stay in touch for new updates!
